sentences.en: The burglar broke into the post office in broad daylight.
sentences.zh: 这个小偷在大白天闯进了邮局。

sentences.en: This road is so broad that buses can pass easily.
sentences.zh: 这条路很宽，公交车可以轻松通行。

sentences.en: A gang of three robbed the bank in broad daylight.
sentences.zh: 三个团伙成员在大白天抢劫了银行。

senses.zh: 宽广的，宽阔的；……宽；咧开嘴的；广泛的，普遍的；大致的，概括的；明确的，明显的；粗俗滑稽的；口音重的
